title: A profile of Garmin CEO Cliff Pemble, who helped diversify its GPS product lines and grew its annual revenue from $2.6B in 2013 to a record $7.2B in 2025 (Brent Crane/Bloomberg)
summary: Brent Crane / Bloomberg: A profile of Garmin CEO Cliff Pemble, who helped diversify its GPS product lines and grew its annual revenue from $2.6B in 2013 to a record $7.2B in 2025 — The company hit $7.2 billion in sales last year across fitness, outdoor, marine, automotive and aviation.
